content.short: LayerHub is an analytics site for looking up wallet and chain activity across Web3.
content.description: LayerHub lets users look up any wallet's on-chain activity and browse chain-level statistics such as daily transactions and total users across many networks. It is popular with airdrop hunters checking their activity. Blockscout's Unichain app marketplace lists it.
content.meta: LayerHub shows wallet and chain activity analytics across Web3 networks, including Unichain.
content.pageTitle: LayerHub - Trading Tools - Lancers Web3 Explorer
